mapper.insert: INSERT INTO restaurant ( user_id, village_id, name, business_start_time, business_end_time, logo_url, address, coordinate_lat, coordinate_lng, phone, notice, license_urls, status, create_time, update_time ) VALUES ( #{userId}, #{villageId}, #{name}, #{businessStartTime}, #{businessEndTime}, #{logoUrl}, #{address}, #{coordinateLat}, #{coordinateLng}, #{phone}, #{notice}, #{licenseUrls}, #{status}, NOW(), NOW() )
mapper.update: UPDATE restaurant SET user_id = #{userId}, village_id = #{villageId}, name = #{name}, business_start_time = #{businessStartTime}, business_end_time = #{businessEndTime}, logo_url = #{logoUrl}, address = #{address}, coordinate_lat = #{coordinateLat}, coordinate_lng = #{coordinateLng}, phone = #{phone}, notice = #{notice}, license_urls = #{licenseUrls}, status = #{status}, update_time = NOW() WHERE id = #{id}
mapper.select: SELECT r.id, r.user_id AS userId, r.village_id AS villageId, r.name, r.business_start_time AS businessStartTime, r.business_end_time AS businessEndTime, r.logo_url AS logoUrl, r.address, r.coordinate_lat AS coordinateLat, r.coordinate_lng AS coordinateLng, r.phone, r.notice, r.license_urls AS licenseUrls, r.status, r.create_time AS createTime, r.update_time AS updateTime, COALESCE(( SELECT COUNT(*) FROM user_collect uc WHERE uc.target_type = 'restaurant' AND uc.target_id = CAST(r.id AS CHAR) ), 0) AS collectNumber, CASE WHEN #{userId} IS NOT NULL AND EXISTS ( SELECT 1 FROM user_collect uc2 WHERE uc2.user_id = #{userId} AND uc2.target_type = 'restaurant' AND uc2.target_id = CAST(r.id AS CHAR) ) THEN 1 ELSE 0 END AS isCollect FROM restaurant r WHERE r.id = #{id}
SELECT id FROM restaurant WHERE name = #{name} LIMIT 1
